formula.combined: 0.60 * mean(B-READY three pillars) + 0.40 * mean(WGI six scores)
formula.wgi_only: mean(WGI six scores); observation only, not comparable to combined score
formula.missing: No imputation; fewer than six WGI dimensions => no reference total
formula.events: No automatic event adjustment or simulated daily changes
